facts.fact: The article says Senegal 'launched' (lancé) the New Deal Technologique in February 2025, which it calls a new national digital strategy; it names no adopting act or body.

systems.country_label: stratégie nationale en matière d'intelligence artificielle

note: Passages only. The document gives the New Deal Technologique a label ('stratégie numérique nationale') but no scope, so class is left empty. It dates the AI strategy contested (2022 or 2023, OECD.AI: officially presented September 2023, roadmap to 2028, 52 actions); that is a thematic strategy, no fact recorded.
